## TRA Timeline

#### Contemplated Up-C IPO

- 2009-10-21: S-1 filed for contemplated Up-C IPO with ICGI Holdings, LLC as TRA counterparty (no TRA exhibit yet)
- 2009-12-08: S-1/A Amendment No. 1 attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.3, 85% sharing
- 2010-01-27: S-1/A Amendment No. 4 re-filed form-of with minor section-heading rewording; same operative terms

#### Withdrawal

- 2010-04-22: Form RW filed withdrawing the registration statement; no IPO, no executed TRA, no subsequent filings under this CIK

## Explanation

Imperial Capital Group was a broker-dealer that filed an S-1 for a contemplated Up-C IPO in October 2009, with a form-of Tax Receivable Agreement attached as Exhibit 10.3 starting in the December 2009 S-1/A. The contract would have obligated the public company to pay ICGI Holdings, LLC 85% of the cash tax savings from Section 754 / 743(b) basis step-ups on the IPO Original Sale and subsequent Exchanges of LP Units. The S-1 was withdrawn on April 22, 2010 before pricing; no IPO, no Up-C, and no executed TRA. Status is recorded as Unknown in the sense that the contract never came into existence. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
